items.key: life is filled with precious moments ones that we wish we could hang on to forever
items.ko: 삶은 소중한 순간들로 가득 차 있죠. 평생 붙잡고 싶은 순간들 말이에요.
items.en: Life is filled with precious moments, ones that we wish we could hang on to forever.

items.key: but our ability to recall everything no matter how much it means to us gets worse and worse over time
items.ko: 하지만 아무리 우리에게 소중한 기억이라도, 모든 것을 기억해 내는 능력은 시간이 지날수록 점점 떨어집니다
items.en: But our ability to recall everything, no matter how much it means to us, gets worse and worse over time.

items.key: and if you dont have an accurate record you may never be able to trust your own version of events
items.ko: 그리고 정확한 기록이 없다면, 자신이 기억하는 일이 정말 사실인지 영영 확신하지 못할 수도 있죠.
items.en: And if you don't have an accurate record, you may never be able to trust your own version of events.

items.key: then youll just end up remembering things someone else wants you to
items.ko: 결국 남들이 기억하라는 대로 기억하게 되는 거죠.
items.en: Then you'll just end up remembering things someone else wants you to.

items.key: but it doesnt have to be this way so stick with me
items.ko: 하지만 꼭 이럴 필요는 없죠. 그러니 계속 지켜봐 주세요.
items.en: But it doesn't have to be this way, so stick with me.

items.key: ill show you how to turn every waking moment into something thats impossible to forget
items.ko: 깨어 있는 모든 순간을 절대 잊을 수 없는 특별한 기억으로 만드는 방법을 알려드릴게요.
items.en: I'll show you how to turn every waking moment into something that's impossible to forget.

items.key: a good memory is one of the most attractive qualities that people can have
items.ko: 기억력이 좋다는 것은 사람이 가질 수 있는 가장 매력적인 자질 중 하나입니다.
items.en: A good memory is one of the most attractive qualities that people can have.

items.key: my memory is not very good and it always made me feel insecure
items.ko: 저는 기억력이 별로 좋지 않아서, 그게 항상 저를 불안하고 자신감 없게 만들었어요.
items.en: My memory is not very good, and it always made me feel insecure.

items.key: its kind of why i started to shoot so much video
items.ko: 그게 제가 영상을 그렇게 많이 찍기 시작한 이유이기도 해요.
items.en: It's kind of why I started to shoot so much video.

items.key: as possible writing down every single thing i do every single day for decades now
items.ko: 가능한 한 많이 기록하면서, 수십 년 동안 매일매일 제가 하는 모든 일을 하나하나 적어왔어요.
items.en: as possible, writing down every single thing I do every single day for decades now.
